scope: 42pt at 3x, native 126x126 pixels; light and dark themes; read-only asset verification.
result: No blocking visual issue found in the 12 inspected frames. No additional geometry adjustment indicated.
observations: Writing at frames 180 and 720 uses two genuinely straight, round-ended strokes with a restrained inward tilt; it reads as focused effort rather than the previous sleepy U curve.
At this native 3x size the strokes remain distinguishable, neither excessively short nor aggressively steep. The spacing is balanced relative to the unchanged hands.
Hold at frame 420 retains the focused eyes. No eye/hand overlap or additional face element appears in either theme.
Frame 900 returns to capsule eyes with hands and writing face hidden. Frame 1050 retains the old concern eyes and sweat; frame 1200 returns cleanly to capsule eyes.
limits: Two actual Rive Apple Runtime 6.25.1 sequences were advanced continuously and encoded to full MOVs; manual visual inspection covered the 12 listed PNGs, not uninterrupted viewing of every movie frame.
126x126 PNGs are native 3x evidence for a 42pt artboard. Physical-device display, actual App placement, energy, and wall-clock performance remain outside this check.
State-change logs use a separate official legacy inspection replay, not the rendered instance.
No Rive asset, App source, interface, or animation track was modified by this QA task.
